verdict.rationale: Statsig documents official client and server SDKs. The evidence shows a quickstart (React StatsigProvider), a JavaScript SDK tutorial, On-Device Eval client SDKs, and server SDKs used for prompt retrieval. The docs say SDKs handle caching, retries and networking and evaluate locally in under 1ms. The HTTP API is positioned as a fallback only when no SDK exists for your language. Community users describe implementing Statsig integrations at multiple companies. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported languages and platforms, and independent hands-on corroboration that names the SDKs specifically.
